entries.10c1151540b6752a: In April 2009, the company transitioned to a pure holding company structure and changed its name from Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. to TOHO HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. Through a company split, the pharmaceutical wholesaling business was transferred to the new Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., and the management business for the dispensing pharmacy business was transferred to Pharma Cluster Co., Ltd. The new Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was established in Tokyo in November 2008, and Pharma Cluster Co., Ltd. in Tokyo in December 2008.
entries.10c7ae70664843c7: This business operates insurance-covered dispensing pharmacies that provide medicines to patients who bring prescriptions. It also provides home medical care support services and sells pharmaceuticals. 6 consolidated subsidiaries (Pharma Daiwa Co., Ltd., J. Mirai Medical Co., Ltd., Pharma Mirai Co., Ltd., Stretchia Co., Ltd., Aobado Co., Ltd. and Kei Create Co., Ltd.), 4 non-consolidated subsidiaries and 3 affiliates carry out the business, and of these, Pharma Cluster Co., Ltd. is a consolidated subsidiary that carries out management operations for the dispensing pharmacy business. Companies in this business receive product supplies from subsidiaries in the pharmaceutical wholesale business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥100,535 million, and sales performance was 105.2% of the same period of the previous year. The dispensing pharmacy companies under Pharma Cluster Co., Ltd. were consolidated from 24 companies as of the end of March 2024 to 4 companies as of April 1, 2026. In addition, to save labor and strengthen pharmacists' in-person work, the company set up a prescription input center and consolidated the prescription input work of each store. The company explains that costs from reorganizing its operating companies came first.

entries.aaa5b59778138eb8: This business purchases pharmaceuticals and medical-related products from pharmaceutical companies and delivers them to hospitals, clinics, dispensing pharmacies, and other customers. It handles pharmaceuticals, narcotics, test drugs, and other products, and medical equipment. It is carried out by 4 consolidated subsidiaries, Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Kyushu Toho Co., Ltd., Seiel Co., Ltd., and Koyo Co., Ltd., and 5 non-consolidated subsidiaries and 4 affiliated companies (Sakai Yakuhin Co., Ltd. and others) also belong to the same business. Products of pharmaceutical companies and others are also supplied to 10 subsidiaries and 3 affiliated companies in the group's dispensing pharmacy business. The same segment also includes Toho System Service Co., Ltd., which contracts for the group's core system operations, and Square One Co., Ltd., which operates a real estate leasing business. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,444,698 million, accounting for most of the company's total net sales of ¥1,553,364 million, and this business's sales results were 102.1% compared with the same period of the previous year. The company explains that, while novel coronavirus-related products continued to shrink, sales grew for products handled exclusively by wholesalers, including anticancer drugs and specialty pharmaceuticals, as well as diabetes treatments, shingles vaccines, and other products. Purchasing results were ¥1,400,976 million (102.0% compared with the same period of the previous year).

entries.eb452a85d0b0ff50: This business manufactures and sells generic drugs and provides contract manufacturing of injectable drugs. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Kyoso Mirai Pharma Co., Ltd. and the affiliates Ayumi Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. and Ayumi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. The generic drugs made by Kyoso Mirai Pharma Co., Ltd. are mainly supplied to the consolidated subsidiary Toho Yakuhin Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥2,654 million, and sales performance was 101.5% of the same period of the previous year. Although revenue from external customers is small, segment revenue including sales within the group, such as to Toho Yakuhin, was ¥11,564 million (up 0.9% from the previous period). In December 2025, the company newly launched 3 generic drug products covering 1 active ingredient. The company also says it is preparing to start contract work at the secondary packaging facility for prescription drugs, the 'Haneda Packaging Center,' within fiscal 2026.
